title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistles to Timothy, Titus, and Philemon, translated by William Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on First Timothy, chapter 1. In his Commentary on the Epistles to Timothy, Titus, and Philemon, in the William Pringle translation, Calvin writes at First Timothy 1, verse 1: Paul an apostle If he had written to Timothy alone, it would have been unnecessary to claim this designation, and to maintain it in the manner that he does. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 19.
